Now tell me. Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?

In the world which you are about to
enter, you will embark on a grand
adventure with you as the hero.

Speak to people and check things
wherever you go, be it towns, roads,
or caves. Gather information and
hints from every source.

New paths will open to you by helping
people in need, overcoming challenges,
and solving mysteries.

At times, you will be challenged by
others and attacked by wild creatures.
Be brave and keep pushing on.

Through your adventure, we hope
that you will interact with all sorts
of people and achieve personal growth.
That is our biggest objective.

Press the A Button, and let your
adventure begin!
Hello, there!\nGlad to meet you!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is OAK.\pPeople affectionately refer to me\nas the POKéMON PROFESSOR.\p
…is inhabited far and wide by\ncreatures called POKéMON.\p
For some people, POKéMON are pets.\nOthers use them for battling.\pAs for myself…\pI study POKéMON as a profession.\p
But first, tell me a little about\nyourself.\p
Let's begin with your name.\nWhat is it?\p
This is my grandson.\pHe's been your rival since you both\nwere babies.\p…Erm, what was his name now?
Your rival's name, what was it now?
That's right! I remember now!\nHis name is {RIVAL}!\p
{PLAYER}!\pYour very own POKéMON legend is\nabout to unfold!\pA world of dreams and adventures\nwith POKéMON awaits! Let's go!
